tabs.content:
assignments

departments

employees

projects

employees
| where salary >= 75000
| project name, salary, salary_string = strcat("$ ", salary)

employees
| join kind=leftouter departments on department_id
| project name, department_id, department_name

employees
| join kind=leftouter departments on department_id
| summarize number_of_employees = count() by department_name

// Use 'take' to view a sample number of records in the table and check the data.
e005_temperature
| where country =='RWANDA'
| sort  by  timestamp desc
